_comment: Size budget for scripts/house-budget.mjs (npm run check:budget). Bytes, gzip -9. 'baseline' is today's app: soft limits, the run fails only when a size grows beyond baseline x (1 + tolerance). 'house' is the new-house target from Tide's budget (audits/new-house-2026-11/team/tide.md section 6); reported as a gap, never fails yet. Refresh the baseline with --update-baseline only when a growth is deliberate and agreed, or after a size win so it cannot creep back.

house._source: tide.md section 6: B1 entry, B2 boot CSS per look, B3 room chunk, B4 tool chunk, B14 offline warm payload. firstPaintJsGz = entry target, since the house shell is the only JS before first paint.
